hero.title: Game of Thrones
hero.subtitle: Explore Westeros and Essos — characters, great houses, and the lands of the realm.

home.introTitle: A world of ice and fire
home.introText: From the Lands of Always Winter to the Red Waste, great houses vie for power. Discover their stories, sigils, and the places that shaped the fate of the Seven Kingdoms.

characters.title: Characters
characters.lead: Lords, queens, bastards, and protectors — those who shaped history.

houses.title: Houses
houses.lead: Sigils, words, and seats of the great houses of Westeros.

map.title: Map of the realms
map.lead: Travel across Westeros and Essos. Click a location to learn more.
map.selectHint: Select a place on the map to view its details.

wheel.title: Wheel of fate
wheel.lead: Let fate choose a character or a house. Spin the wheel and see who the Iron Throne marks.
wheel.hint: Spin the wheel to reveal your draw.
